result.summary: Scope test run against `git diff main...HEAD`. Full diff touches exactly two things: (1) web/package.json -- one line changed, `"type-check": "tsc --noEmit"` -> `"type-check": "tsc -b tsconfig.json"`, a dev-tooling npm script invocation fixing a build-tooling no-op bug (ISS-0274); no other lines in the file changed. (2) handoffs/WF03-ISS0274-20260822/* -- pipeline audit-trail JSON files (step-00-git-setup.json etc.), not application code. Ran the scope test's five criteria: no API route reading/writing tenant-scoped data touched; no priv/repo/migrations/*.exs migration added or modified; no secret-resolving code (config/env var/token) added or modified; no response-shaping code for a tenant-scoped entity touched; no lookup-by-ID handler touched. This is a TypeScript compiler invocation flag change in a package.json script -- it affects how `npm run type-check` is invoked locally/in CI, not any runtime behavior, API surface, database access, or secret handling. Verdict: OUT OF SCOPE -- no tenant-data path touched. Per docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md's scope test, when none of the five triggers apply the correct disposition is to record that explicitly and complete with status PASS rather than forcing a per-invariant walk against code that never approaches tenant data. No BLOCKER or other issues found.
